Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 13  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in step 13 when it incorrectly concluded that Prashanta Nanda, the director of Naiyya, was born earlier than Robert M. Young. The birth dates provided clearly show that Robert M. Young was born on November 22, 1924, while Prashanta Nanda was born on May 2, 1947. Therefore, Robert M. Young was born first. The Planner failed to correctly compare the birth dates and incorrectly stated that Prashanta Nanda was older, leading to the wrong solution to the problem.
